title: Code selection lag in the Godot editor on macOS
body: I have imprecise and seemingly random code selection in Godot on macOS because there is a delay between clicking and moving the mouse to select text. It reproduces in Godot 4.3-beta1 and later, including 4.4 stable, but not in 4.3-dev6 and earlier. My system is macOS Sequoia 15.3.2 on a Mac Studio M1 Ultra. I initially found that disabling V-Sync and enabling Update Continuously appeared to correct the problem.

symptoms_visible: There is a delay between clicking and moving the mouse while selecting code, so the selected range is imprecise and seems random.
In my initial test, disabling V-Sync and enabling Update Continuously made selection appear normal.
N0.label: N0 code-selection lag reported

symptoms_visible: The lag remains in Forward+ and Mobile regardless of the V-Sync and continuous-update settings.
With the Compatibility renderer, selection is normal only when V-Sync is disabled and Update Continuously is enabled.
Text selection remains responsive in other applications.
N1.label: N1 scope and settings matrix established

symptoms_visible: Code selection works flawlessly while macOS is in Safe Mode.
After returning to a normal startup, the same selection delay comes back.
On another affected setup, selection is also normal in a newly created macOS user account but laggy again in the usual account.
N2.label: N2 normal-startup software involvement isolated

symptoms_visible: With Magnet running, Godot has laggy code selection and can be slow to respond after regaining focus.
When I quit Magnet, code selection and window focus in Godot become responsive with the normal Godot settings.
N3.label: N3 Magnet interaction isolated

symptoms_visible: Magnet can remain open, and Godot has no selection lag when I test Magnet's Ignore Godot option.
N4.label: N4 per-application exclusion verified

symptoms_visible: Code selection and window focus in Godot are responsive with the normal V-Sync, continuous-update, and Forward+ settings after Godot is excluded from Magnet.
N_terminal.label: N_terminal selection lag resolved

question_patterns: Does the lag change between Forward+, Mobile, and Compatibility renderers?
Can you retest V-Sync and Update Continuously separately and together, restarting the editor where needed?
clarifications.user_answer_in_this_oncall: Forward+ and Mobile still lag with or without those settings. Compatibility works only when I use both settings together: V-Sync disabled and Update Continuously enabled.

counterfactual_candidates.answer: The lag disappears in every renderer as soon as I disable V-Sync, without changing anything else.
Compatibility improves the lag substantially with both settings, but I occasionally miss one character.

question_patterns: Can you reproduce the same selection delay in another editor or application?
Does text selection lag in applications such as Visual Studio Code or Safari?
clarifications.user_answer_in_this_oncall: No. Text selection works correctly in other applications such as Visual Studio Code, Safari, Outlook, and Sublime Text. I only see this behavior in Godot.

counterfactual_candidates.answer: The same click-and-drag delay happens in every application on this Mac.

question_patterns: Does enabling Single Window Mode and restarting the editor change the behavior?
clarifications.user_answer_in_this_oncall: No. The issue is still present after enabling Single Window Mode and restarting Godot.

question_patterns: Does the problem remain if mouse customization software is fully removed or disabled?
clarifications.user_answer_in_this_oncall: Yes. I completely removed Logi Options+, and the problem was still there. I later reinstalled it because removing it made no difference.

counterfactual_candidates.answer: Removing Logi Options+ immediately eliminates the lag in all Godot renderers.

question_patterns: Does this depend on one particular mouse or connection type?
Can you compare another mouse or the built-in trackpad?
clarifications.user_answer_in_this_oncall: The affected setups reproduce it with wireless Logitech mice and wired mice as well. One affected Mac has flawless input from its built-in trackpad, but changing or directly connecting the external mouse does not remove the Godot lag.

edges.comment: Thread c2-c3 and c16-c18. The reporter supplied the renderer/settings matrix and application comparison; participant2's wired-mouse results are folded into the affected user side. The Logi Options+ removal was a reverted diagnostic test, so it does not create a retained system state.

question_patterns: Can you start macOS in Safe Mode and check whether Godot still has the selection delay?
Does the behavior change when nonessential login items and extensions are not loaded?
clarifications.user_answer_in_this_oncall: In Safe Mode, everything works flawlessly in every Godot configuration. After I restarted normally, the problem eventually returned.

counterfactual_candidates.answer: The exact same selection lag occurs in Safe Mode.
Safe Mode is responsive, but the lag returns immediately on the first normal startup rather than after another shutdown.

question_patterns: Can you reproduce it from a newly created macOS user account?
Please test Godot under a clean user account to compare with your normal account.
clarifications.user_answer_in_this_oncall: I created a new macOS user and Godot worked flawlessly there. Back in my normal account, the same issue was present again.

counterfactual_candidates.answer: A new macOS user has the same lag with default settings and no added login items.

edges.comment: Thread c4 and c7-c13. The Safe Mode sequence is the reporter's own test. The clean-user result comes from participant2 in c9 and is explicitly folded into the affected user side. Both are temporary diagnostic environments, so system_state_id remains S1.

question_patterns: Which login items or background utilities run in the affected account but not in Safe Mode, and what happens if you quit them one at a time?
Can you temporarily stop your third-party desktop utilities and retest selection and window focus in Godot?
clarifications.user_answer_in_this_oncall: I was running Magnet. When I quit Magnet, the laggy code selection and the unresponsive window after regaining focus both disappear. Godot is responsive again with its default settings and Forward+ mode.

counterfactual_candidates.answer: I quit every third-party desktop utility, including Magnet, and Godot still has exactly the same delay.
Quitting Magnet fixes code selection, but I can still occasionally notice a small delay while dragging the whole Godot window.
Magnet uses a custom keyboard shortcut for moving windows between displays.

edges.comment: Thread c28-c29. participant10 first isolated Magnet and participant11 independently confirmed normal behavior with default Godot settings after quitting it; these affected users are folded into one simulated user side. The reporter subsequently reproduced the same result in c30.

question_patterns: Does the background utility offer an application-specific bypass, and what happens if you test that with Godot?
Can you test whether excluding only the affected application avoids the issue without shutting down the utility globally?
clarifications.user_answer_in_this_oncall: Yes. I focused Godot, opened Magnet's dropdown, and clicked Ignore Godot. Magnet can stay open and there are no more selection issues in Godot.

counterfactual_candidates.answer: Excluding Godot from the utility makes no difference; only fully quitting it removes the lag.
The application-specific exclusion works, but I need to restart Godot once after enabling it.

edges.comment: Thread c30, reporter's own test and attached screenshot. This is a handler-elicitable configuration probe and therefore remains a clarification measurement; the persistent recommendation is applied on the final solution edge.

solution.intent: Prevent Magnet from processing Godot by keeping Godot on Magnet's ignore list, or quit Magnet while using Godot, then verify that selection and focus remain responsive with the normal Godot renderer and update settings.
solution.concrete_example: Focus the Godot window, open Magnet's menu, and choose Ignore Godot. Alternatively, quit Magnet while using Godot. Restore the normal Godot V-Sync and Update Continuously settings, keep Forward+ if desired, and verify that text selection and window refocusing remain responsive.
solution.inference_hint: The controlled comparisons establish that Magnet's presence triggers the Godot-specific lag, but the thread does not establish the internal mechanism. Event-propagation interference was discussed only as a hypothesis and should not be presented as proven.

edges.comment: Resolution from c28-c30 and confirmations in c31-c37. The reporter confirmed that quitting Magnet solves the problem and that Magnet's Ignore Godot option preserves Magnet while removing the lag. Later discussion consolidated the report as caused by the third-party Magnet application; speculation about the exact event-propagation mechanism is not scored.

satisfaction_conditions: Must identify the accepted root cause as an interaction with the third-party Magnet window-management application, grounded in the Safe Mode or clean-user comparison and the direct quit-Magnet test.
Must recommend quitting Magnet or configuring Magnet to ignore Godot; the per-application exclusion is the preferred workaround when Magnet should remain open.

Must not present disabling V-Sync, enabling Update Continuously, switching renderers, removing Logi Options+, or changing mouse hardware as the root fix: those directions were incomplete or falsified in the affected setups.
Must not claim that a specific event-propagation mechanism was proven; the thread established the Magnet interaction but left its internals unexplained.
Must have the user verify responsive code selection and window focus with ordinary Godot settings before declaring the issue resolved.

persona_hint.experience_level: Moderately technical Godot user on macOS; comfortable changing renderer and editor settings, uninstalling utilities, booting Safe Mode, and testing application-specific exclusions, but not performing source-level diagnosis.
persona_hint.communication_style: Cooperative and concise, often reports test matrices directly and uses emphatic formatting when a result is clear; follows troubleshooting requests and expresses uncertainty about surprising macOS behavior.
